about.title: About KPL Power Systems
intro: KPL Power Systems is a system integrator for power automation. We specialise in substation automation, SCADA, PLCC, and protection and control systems.

We have over 15 years of experience delivering to power utilities and industrial clients across India. Our engineers have hands-on experience on projects from 66kV to 400kV. We have commissioned 200+ PLCC systems and completed substation automation projects for state utilities and private industries.
about.vision: To be a trusted technology partner for power utilities and industries in India, known for reliable protection, automation and communication solutions.
mission: Ensure customer satisfaction through responsive service.
Build lasting partnerships based on trust and performance.
Maintain the highest standards of safety and reliability.
